courses.overview: 從「James Webb 太空望遠鏡」延伸到兩項可直接開啟的逐步課程；下列比較分別說明相似原理、差異與驗證練習，並附代表地點、地址或地理描述與近似座標。
courses.overviewEn: Extend James Webb Space Telescope into two directly accessible guided courses. Each comparison identifies shared principles, differences and verification exercises, with a representative location, address or geographical descriptor and approximate coordinates.

related.title: Landsat 地球觀測計畫
related.why: 把「James Webb 太空望遠鏡」與「Landsat 地球觀測計畫」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare James Webb Space Telescope with Landsat Earth-observation program: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

place.address: USGS EROS Center Sioux Falls South Dakota

place.coordinateScope: 公開代表定位點，座標為近似值；依地點可能是工程、園區、博物館、入口或城市，並非整體工程邊界。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

related.transfer: 太空科學儀器都要把光學、偵測器、熱控制、指向和地面校準資料接成量測鏈。
related.transferEn: Space instruments connect optics, detectors, thermal control, pointing and ground calibration into a measurement chain.
related.difference: Landsat 量測地球表面；Webb 觀測遠方天體，波段、軌道、熱環境和校準目標不同。
related.differenceEn: Landsat measures Earth’s surface; Webb observes distant astronomical targets, differing in bands, orbit, thermal environment and calibration targets.
practice: 追蹤光子到可用資料的路徑
比較地球與天文目標的背景
列出儀器讀值轉為科學資料的修正
practiceEn: List corrections from instrument readings to science data

related.title: 消色差透鏡設計
related.why: 把「James Webb 太空望遠鏡」與「消色差透鏡設計」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare James Webb Space Telescope with Achromatic lens design: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

place.name: Edmund Optics Barrington 代表據點
place.mapQuery: Edmund Optics, 101 East Gloucester Pike, Barrington, NJ 08007, USA
place.address: Edmund Optics, 101 East Gloucester Pike, Barrington, NJ 08007, USA
place.addressEn: Edmund Optics, 101 East Gloucester Pike, Barrington, NJ 08007, USA
place.coordinateScope: 公開代表定位點，座標為近似值；依地點可能是工程、園區、博物館、入口或城市，並非整體工程邊界。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

related.transfer: 精密光學要以波段、像差和熱形變建立誤差預算，最後用實測波前或影像驗證。
related.transferEn: Precision optics require error budgets for wavelength, aberrations and thermal distortion, followed by wavefront or image measurements.
related.difference: 消色差透鏡補償折射色散；Webb 使用分段反射鏡和低溫環境，主要問題是鏡段共相與熱穩定。
related.differenceEn: Achromatic lenses compensate refractive dispersion; Webb uses segmented mirrors in a cold environment, emphasizing segment phasing and thermal stability.
practice: 比較雙合透鏡與分段反射鏡
標出溫度變化會改變的尺寸
為色差與鏡段失準各選一種觀察量
practiceEn: Compare a doublet with a segmented reflector
Choose observables for chromatic error and segment misalignment

history.title: Webb 發射

history.textEn: Webb launched from French Guiana on December 25, 2021, beginning deployment and commissioning; Goddard is the management center, not the launch site.

history.title: 首批科學影像公開

history.textEn: NASA released first science images and spectra in July 2022, demonstrating integrated optics, thermal control and instruments.

courses.summary: Webb 由 NASA、ESA 與 CSA 合作，Goddard 負責 NASA 任務管理與相關研發整合。望遠鏡本體在日地 L2 附近軌道，不能在地球 Google Map 上標出本體；此處選的是與工程歷史有關的地面機構。
courses.summaryEn: Webb is a NASA–ESA–CSA collaboration, with Goddard managing the mission for NASA and supporting integration. The telescope orbits near Sun–Earth L2 and cannot be located on an Earth Google Map; this marker identifies a relevant ground institution.
courses.connection: 比較 Webb、Landsat 的校準與太空熱設計，再比較地面消色差光學，理解共同原理與不同環境。
courses.connectionEn: Compare Webb and Landsat calibration and space thermal design, then terrestrial achromatic optics, separating shared principles from different environments.

roles.role: JWST 的主承包商（遮陽罩、太空船與整合）。
roles.roleEn: JWST prime contractor (sunshield, spacecraft and integration).
roles.business: 航太國防集團，為 JWST 主承包商並建造 Landsat 9 衛星本體。
roles.businessEn: Aerospace and defence group; prime contractor for JWST and builder of the Landsat 9 spacecraft.

roles.role: 旗下前 Ball Aerospace 負責 JWST 鈹主鏡光學系統。
roles.roleEn: Its former Ball Aerospace unit delivered JWST’s beryllium mirror optics.
roles.business: 英國航太國防集團，2024 年收購 Ball Aerospace（JWST 光學、Landsat OLI）。
roles.businessEn: UK aerospace and defence group that acquired Ball Aerospace (JWST optics, Landsat OLI) in 2024.

courses.connection: 從「James Webb 太空望遠鏡」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in James Webb Space Telescope. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.
